title: Little Victories
description: Every mob you defeat throws a tiny celebration: particles, cheers, and loot.
body:
# Little Victories

Combat in Minecraft is so quiet. You swing, something dies, and then nothing.
**Little Victories** fixes that. Every time a creature falls, the world throws
a tiny party about it.

## What happens on every death
-  A burst of celebration particles: hearts, sparkles, and a flash of light
-  A cheerful chime to mark the moment
-  A random word of encouragement in your action bar ("Encore!", "The crowd goes wild!", and more)
-  A **1-in-4 chance** to drop a little treat where they fell: diamonds, emeralds, golden apples, amethyst, and other goodies

It works for **any** living thing that dies, whether you landed the blow or just
happened to be nearby. The cheer text only shows for the player who got the kill.

## Notes
- Server-friendly: all logic runs server-side, so vanilla clients can join.
- Lightweight and self-contained. No config needed, no commands, just vibes.

## Requirements
- Minecraft **26.2**
- **Fabric Loader** 0.19.3+
- **Fabric API**
